verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript framework whose documented programmatic surface (workflow methods like .then()/.branch()/.parallel()) drives agents and workflows. It runs a Mastra server that can ship agents and workflows as standalone endpoints, and machine-readable docs exist (llms.txt, docs.md). However, no endpoint-level public HTTP API reference is evidenced, and OpenAPI probes on mastra.ai returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP API reference or OpenAPI spec for the server endpoints, auth and usage details for driving a deployed Mastra/Mastra Cloud instance, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
